# Shalini Choudhary: SEO, GEO and AEO Strategy Leader

Fluent in search & growth. Native to revenue.

Shalini Choudhary is an SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) strategy leader specialising in search-led growth since 2016. Her career spans agency, real estate, media and global higher education: Ogilvy (Digital Marketing Analyst, Sep 2016 to Jan 2019), JLL (Digital Marketing Analyst, Feb 2019 to Oct 2019), GroupM, WPP Group (Marketing Manager, Digital and Integrated Marketing, Nov 2019 to Jan 2022), and Global University Systems, GUS (Senior SEO Manager, Digital Portfolio and Content Strategy, Feb 2022 to Sep 2025).

She holds an MSc in Marketing Management with Advertising from the University of Leeds (First Class, Sep 2025 to Sep 2026), where her dissertation examined hyper-personalised Instagram ads and consumer purchasing decisions, and an MA in Media Studies from Haridev Joshi University, India (First Class, 2013 to 2015). In 2026, she was shortlisted among the top 13 UK teams in the CIM x IBM "The Pitch" competition for a GBP 400K go-to-market strategy involving AI-driven commercial marketing, designing a multi-channel growth loop for "Green AI" and pitching it to IBM and CIM leadership. She also serves as a voluntary Marketing Associate at 180 Degrees Consulting Leeds.

## Verified Proof Points

### Global University Systems, GUS (Feb 2022 to Sep 2025)
- Organic traffic +65% YoY with no paid amplification; qualified leads +20% YoY.
- One-year SEO page performance: 9,800 leads converted into 3,200 applications, creating an application pipeline of roughly INR 416 crore at INR 13 lakh average programme value (application pipeline, before enrolment conversion).
- Replatformed two legacy education brand sites onto Drupal with zero ranking loss, under 5% traffic variance, and full recovery within one month.
- Increased citations by 15-20% on restructured deep content pages (answer-first passages, FAQ, schema). Built entity signals and a hub-and-spoke content model after Ahrefs and SEMrush visibility tests showed low initial AI visibility, supported by Reddit and forum answers and genuine review growth on GMB and education portals.
- Reported AI visibility KPIs: brand mention rate, citation count and share, AI share of voice, AI Overview presence, sentiment, and AI referral traffic, alongside organic traffic, engagement and conversion.
- Lifted lead-to-application conversion by 10-12% and reduced bounce rate by 15-20% across 50-60K annual leads converting at roughly 30% lead-to-application.
- Reduced content production time by 40% through AI-enabled workflows.
- Led a team of 7-10 (5 SEO specialists, 2 content writers, 1 analyst) and built the cross-functional operating model with dev, brand and analytics leads.
- Delivered an annual organic roadmap signed off by the CBO and marketing director, gave weekly briefings to leadership on AI answers reducing organic clicks, defended SEO investment by tracing Salesforce-tracked leads from SEO pages, and built executive dashboards in Looker Studio alongside audit templates, playbooks and stakeholder training.

### GroupM, WPP Group (Nov 2019 to Jan 2022)
- Won the Ford pitch by owning the website technical analysis and the competitor and market analysis.
- Grew non-branded organic traffic by 20% at zero budget, outperforming paid on the same queries.
- Led 5-6 SEO and marketing specialists delivering international SEO across Americas and MENA for clients including Ford, PepsiCo and Zee5.
- Contributed to pitches, proposals and scoping, presented performance data to client stakeholders, and built investment rationale when budgets were under scrutiny.

### JLL (Feb 2019 to Oct 2019)
- Delivered multi-market SEO across EMEA and APAC on a globally indexed domain.
- Deployed entity-level schema on sites with thousands of pages and regional sites of 100-200 pages, authoring audit templates and playbooks for global regional sites.

### Ogilvy (Sep 2016 to Jan 2019)
- Managed SEO across 10+ accounts in automotive, luxury, healthcare and e-commerce, delivering international SEO across Americas and MENA and contributing SEO sections of client pitch decks.

## Case Studies

- [GUS Drupal Migration](https://shalinichoudhary.in/work/gus-migration.html): Two legacy education brand sites replatformed onto Drupal with zero ranking loss, under 5% traffic variance, and full recovery within one month.
- [GUS AI Discovery & GEO](https://shalinichoudhary.in/work/gus-ai-discovery.html): Reversing AI-answer traffic erosion through answer-first content restructuring, schema, entity signals, and a +15-20% citation gain.
- [GUS Organic Growth Pipeline](https://shalinichoudhary.in/work/gus-growth-pipeline.html): Scaling an INR 416 crore application pipeline (before enrolment conversion) from 9,800 SEO leads and 3,200 applications, with +65% YoY organic traffic growth.
- [GroupM Ford Pitch & Non-Branded Growth](https://shalinichoudhary.in/work/groupm-ford-pitch.html): Winning the Ford pitch through technical and market analysis and driving +20% non-branded organic traffic at zero budget.
- [International SEO at JLL & Ogilvy](https://shalinichoudhary.in/work/international-seo-jll-ogilvy.html): Multi-market SEO across EMEA, APAC, Americas and MENA, entity-level schema at scale, and 10+ global brand accounts.
